verdict.rationale: Foreloop runs its own agents (feedback triage, PR review), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack only shows the reverse direction: the MCP mention [foreloop-docs-28] lets outside agents read and update Foreloop, which is server-side and does not count here. No evidence shows Foreloop connecting to or using tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
